story.title: The Time Stitch
story.logline: A tailor alters a vintage coat and discovers every stitch removes a year from his own life.
story.theme: The hidden cost of mending the past.
story.twist: The coat belongs to his future self, who already altered it out of existence.
story.ending: Would you rewrite your history if it meant vanishing before you finished the final seam?

scenes.narration: My hands stopped shaking the exact moment the heavy wool coat whispered my true name out loud.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, a 25-year-old tailor with messy brown hair and a worn denim apron, in a dimly lit, cluttered sewing shop.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up tracking shot on the moving fabric

scenes.narration: I never asked to inherit this cursed sewing machine or the dusty tailor shop left behind by my uncle.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim apron, staring at an antique brass sewing machine in his cluttered shop.

scenes.narration: Each time I fix a torn seam on this heavy coat, a piece of my own memory vanishes forever.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, in his workshop, holding a golden needle near dark wool as his eyes glaze over slightly.
scenes.camera: Rack focus from needle to his face

scenes.narration: I lost my first heartbreak while repairing the left sleeve. I couldn't even remember her face anymore.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim apron, touching his head with a pained expression in the dim shop.

scenes.narration: Greed whispered in my ear. I pulled tighter threads to fix the frayed collar and win back my lost youth.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim apron, aggressively pulling a thick red thread through the dark wool coat.

scenes.narration: Suddenly, a silver pocket watch fell from the heavy lining, ticking backward with a deafening, metallic rhythm.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, in his workshop, catching an antique silver watch as it drops from the coat.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Leo

scenes.narration: Engraved on the back was my own handwriting, warning me to stop sewing before it was too late.
scenes.visual_prompt: Macro shot of the watch back held by Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim apron, illuminated by a single desk lamp.

scenes.narration: I looked in the cracked mirror and saw a stranger staring back: younger, paler, and fading into dust.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim apron, looking into a dusty mirror where his reflection is translucent.

scenes.narration: The coat was never an inheritance. It was a trap laid by the man I am slowly becoming.
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim apron, standing alone as the dark wool coat drapes over an empty chair.

scenes.narration: My fingers touched the final button, and the thread snapped, taking my entire existence into the silent dark.
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a worn denim apron, as his hand turns into glowing dust particles.

caption.title: The Time Stitch
caption.caption: Arthur thought he was merely fixing a flaw in an old coat. But as the threads pulled tight, so did the countdown on his own existence, leading him to a terrifying final alter.
